name: Sprocket
text: We should implement A/B testing for the new feature with 5% of users. This approach allows us to gather data on user interactions and effectiveness before a full rollout, minimizing potential negative impacts on overall user experience. The trade-off here is the slower initial rollout, but it helps ensure that we make data-driven decisions that improve quality and user satisfaction in the long run.

name: Gauge
text: A/B testing with only 5% of users risks missing critical insights due to insufficient data. A better alternative is a 10% blind rollout to users who opted in. This offers a larger sample size, reducing the chance of missing significant trends while still allowing us to monitor user interactions effectively. To settle the argument, we could run a quick analysis on expected sample sizes and potential insights needed for a thorough evaluation.
